final: WITH inv AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country AS Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), dev AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, avg_price, avg_price - (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM inv) AS deviation FROM inv), cdev AS (SELECT Country, AVG(deviation) AS country_dev FROM dev GROUP BY Country) SELECT d.InvoiceId, d.Country, d.avg_price, d.deviation, d.deviation - cd.country_dev AS dev_minus_country_dev FROM dev d JOIN cdev cd ON cd.Country IS d.Country ORDER BY dev_minus_country_dev IS NULL, dev_minus_country_dev DESC LIMIT 10
